subtitle: All-payer hospital care  ·  NHE national total $1,501B (2023)  ·  CMS NHE Table 7 / AHA / BLS

hi_hospitals_claims.label: Private insurance + MA + MCO claims
hi_hospitals_claims.note: Commercial PHI direct (~$506B, 33.7%) + Medicare Advantage & Medicaid MCO passthrough to hospitals

medicare_hospitals_ffs.label: Medicare FFS (inpatient + outpatient)
medicare_hospitals_ffs.note: Direct FFS; total Medicare hospital incl. MA ~$411B = 27.4% of national hospital care

medicaid_hospitals_ffs.label: Medicaid FFS + DSH
medicaid_hospitals_ffs.note: Direct FFS + disproportionate-share; total Medicaid hospital incl. MCO ~$294B = 19.6%

ind_hospitals_oop.label: Out-of-pocket (copays, deductibles)
ind_hospitals_oop.note: 2.5% of national hospital care; CMS NHE Table 7 ~$37B

fed_hospitals_vadod.label: VA, DoD & TRICARE hospital care
fed_hospitals_vadod.note: VA medical centers + DoD MTFs + TRICARE inpatient; fills the 'other payer' share of hospital revenue that the payer rows above don't trace

emp_hospitals_workerscomp.label: Workers' compensation (hospital)
emp_hospitals_workerscomp.note: Employer-funded workers-comp & occupational-injury hospital care; part of the same other-payer residual

hospitals_workers_labor.label: Labor — wages, benefits, contract staff (~54%)
hospitals_workers_labor.note: 5.6M workers; RNs ~$200B · employed physicians ~$125B · other clinical ~$210B · admin/support ~$150B · contract/agency ~$75B (AHA 2023 / BLS OES)

hospitals_suppliers_nonlabor.label: Non-labor — supplies, drugs, capital, services (~44%)
hospitals_suppliers_nonlabor.note: Supplies/drugs/devices ~$225B · other operating (utilities, malpractice, bad debt) ~$235B · capital & depreciation ~$95B · purchased services ~$75B · interest ~$30B (AHA 2023)

hospitals_capital_margin.label: Net margin → capital markets (~2%)
hospitals_capital_margin.note: AHA industry-average operating margin 3-5%; varies widely by system and payer mix

checks.note: CMS NHE 2023 Table 7 = $1,501B; the cost-structure outflows decompose the full national total
AHA Hospital Statistics: community ~$1.29T + non-community ~$0.18T ≈ $1.47T (independent cost-report basis)
BLS: healthcare-sector labor ~55-57% of output; labor ÷ NHE national $1,501B

notes: Dual-billing — hospital-employed physicians (~52% of all physicians) generate TWO NHE revenue streams:
a facility fee (counted here in Hospital Care, paid out via Hospitals → Healthcare Workers) AND a
professional fee (counted in Physician & Clinical, paid via that node's labor). Same physicians, two NHE
categories — shown separately to match CMS accounting, so the ~$125B of employed-physician comp in
hospital labor is NOT double-counted with physician-services comp on the Physician & Clinical sheet.
